summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K regarding a First Amendment to its Shareholders Agreement among Petrobras, Shine I Multi-Strategy Equity Investment Fund, and Shine Equity LP. The fund agreed to acquire 226,334,622 common shares and 47,294,173 Class A preferred shares from NSP Investimentos S.A., leading to a new shareholders' agreement effective upon that acquisition. This amendment governs shared control and governance improvements. No deal price, premium, or specific financial terms are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary governance update, not a classic special situation. Watch for regulatory approval and closing of the share transfer.
